function.arguments: {"finding": "The data shows that female patients have a higher response rate than male patients in the control arm (F: 75.8% vs M: 68.5%), but a lower response rate in the treatment arm (F: 59.4% vs M: 66.9%). The treatment arm has equal numbers of males and females (160 each), but the control arm has more females (252) than males (276). Since the control arm has a higher overall response rate (71.5%) than the treatment arm (63.1%), the imbalance in gender distribution across arms leads to a higher average response rate in females when aggregated across arms.", "implication": "The question assumes that females respond better overall, but this is a spurious correlation due to confounding by treatment arm.
